raw_context:
VitalConnect does not operate as a broad distributor or seller of multi-brand third-party medical equipment or outside manufacturer goods. Instead, VitalConnect designs, manufactures, and sells its own proprietary medical-grade wearable biosensors
and remote patient monitoring software platforms.
Cardiovascular Business
Core Proprietary Products
VitalPatch
: An FDA-cleared, single-use wearable biosensor patch that records continuous single-lead ECG, heart rate, heart rate variability, respiratory rate, body temperature, posture, and fall detection.
Cardiovascular Business
HealthPatch
: A multi-parameter biosensor designed for tracking key vital signs.
VitalCenter
: A central software and cloud-based platform used by clinicians to monitor real-time data feeds and telemetry alerts streamed from the wearable patches.
Cardiovascular Business
Distribution and Market Focus
Direct Technology Provider
: VitalConnect markets its own branded hardware and software ecosystem to hospitals, clinics, and research institutions rather than acting as an independent medical device distributor for other corporate brands.
Regional Expansion
: The company deploys its proprietary tech into international territories like the Asia-Pacific region via direct sales channels, regional partnerships, and healthcare integration agreements.

VitalConnect products are centered around the
VitalPatch
and
VitalConnect Solution
for wireless, multi-vitals biosensing, utilized globally via direct distribution and international medical device pathways. Following its acquisition by
iRhythm Technologies
, its core sensor ecosystem integrates into broader ambulatory and remote cardiac infrastructures.
VitalConnect
Product Brands & Technologies
VitalPatch:
Single-use, wearable 7-day biosensor patch that streams single-lead ECG, heart rate, respiratory rate, body temperature, and posture data.
Business Wire
VitalPatch RTM:
Specialized configuration focused on real-time ambulatory and remote cardiac rhythm telemetry.
VitalConnect
VitalConnect Solution:
Telehealth-enabled cloud and mobile software framework that aggregates real-time streams of up to 11 patient vital signs.
